payload.core_composition_summary: Sort both players' letters, then two-pointer greedy to build minimal possible string by placing smallest/largest letters at extremes.
payload.rationale: Sorting enables optimal greedy comparisons and placement using two pointers; both mechanisms coordinated to achieve game Oleg minimizes, Igor maximizes.
